newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa higher, coffee sags, sugar mixed.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa higher, coffee sags, sugar mixed.

text.p: COCOA - Higher in light trade but activity dominated by December crosses. Dec up eight stg at 1,039 stg at midday.
COFFEE - Lower in switch-led trade. Nov off $30 at $1,474 after a low at $1,445. Sell-stops seen at $1,475.
SUGAR - Tightly mixed in thin trade with players awaiting New York follow-through buying. Oct down 60 cents at $328.00.
